What is WBJEE?

West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination, also known as WBJEE is conducted as a state level exam by WBJEEB authorities. WBJEE is held annually to select candidates for admission into undergraduate courses offered at state universities, government colleges and self-financing engineering & technical institutions. For admission, candidates have to qualify entrance examination. JEE Main qualified candidates who meet basic eligibility can apply for admission through WBJEE counselling.
How is WBJEE exam conducted?

WBJEE is conducted as an offline test. During exam, candidates have to answer questions in OMR sheet provided by authorities. Candidates have to attempt all 155 questions from Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. Overall, questions will be from 11th and 12th standard syllabus. To be eligible for admission, candidates have to qualify WBJEE with valid scores.
WBJEE Paper Timings

WBJEE is held as two papers - Paper 1 (Mathematics) and Paper 2 (Physics and Chemistry). Both papers will be held in one day and candidates will have to attempt both to qualify for BTech admission. Candidates can check paper timings for WBJEE exam below.

The students should also have minimum 60% in Mathematics and a pass mark in English.

BITS Pilani conducts the BITSAT exam for admission to undergraduate programs like Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm), and integrated Master’s courses in science and technology across the BITS campuses. Over the years, BITSAT has become popular not only for admission into the prestigious BITS campuses in Pilani, Goa, and Hyderabad, but also for the exam and merit-based selection process. The BITSAT exam is conducted in online mode, and around 3 lakh students apply for it every year. However, the authorities also accept direct admissions for board toppers who meet the required eligibility criteria.

faqs.answer: During BITSAT preparation, students should revise every day. Revising regularly will help them not easily forget what they have already studied. Doing revision daily will help students pace their preparation.

faqs.question: What is the BITSAT 2026 slot booking date?
faqs.answer: BITSAT 2026 slot booking dates will be announced soon. Separate slot booking process will be open for the two sessions of the exam. Students will have book their slots separately for the different exam sessions. The official BITSAT slot booking 2026 dates will be announced online.

faqs.question: How can I log in for BITSAT slot booking?
faqs.answer: For BITSAT slot booking, students will have to log in with application form number and password. Once they are logged in, they will have to book their exam slots. No offline slot booking will be done by authorities.

faqs.question: Why do I see less options in the BITSAT slot booking facility?
faqs.answer: If students log in late to complete BITSAT slot booking, then there are chances that preferred slots are filled up and unavailable. Students should login and complete slot booking as soon as possible.

faqs.question: When will BITSAT 2026 admit card be available?
faqs.answer: The BITSAT 2026 admit card date for session 1 is April 5, 2026. Candidates can access the BITSAT admit card 2026 for session 2 on May 20, 2026. Candidates have to check their test city allotment first, book their slots, and then download their admit cards.

faqs.question: How to download the BITSAT admit card?
faqs.answer: BITSAT admit card will be available at bitsadmission.com. To download hall ticket, students will have to log in with application number and password. After logging in, admit card has to be downloaded and printed out.

faqs.question: Will BITSAT admit card be sent through email or post?
faqs.answer: Students will not receive their BITSAT admit card through email or post. After hall ticket is released, students will have to login at official website and download it. Authorities will not use any other mode to make admit card available.

faqs.question: What is the BITSAT 2026 result date?
faqs.answer: BITSAT 2026 result will be released a few weeks after the exam concludes. While the students will be able to check their scores immediately after the exam ends, the moderated scores will be released through the result. For every exam session, the results will be announced.

faqs.question: Which information will be available in the BITSAT result?
faqs.answer: Through the BITSAT result, the students will be able to check their scores obtained in the exam. No ranks will be available in the result. Students will be able to download the result in the form of BITSAT score card for future use.

faqs.question: Can I request to review my BITSAT score?

faqs.question: Is there a direct admission scheme in BITSAT counselling?

faqs.question: How are seats allotted in BITSAT counselling?
faqs.answer: During BITSAT counselling, students will be allotted according to rank and preferences. Allotment result will be announced in form of iterations. Once students are allotted, they will have to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: What is the BITSAT 2026 counselling date?
faqs.answer: BITSAT 2026 counselling process will start after the result is announced. For selection into the courses offered by the participating campuses, the students will have to participate in the BITSAT counselling process. During the counselling, the students will have to submit their preferences and pay the fee for allotment.

faqs.question: Does the BITSAT cutoff differ for every category?
faqs.answer: Yes, the BITSAT cutoff will be different for every campus, course and category. The students may find that the cutoff score for popular courses and campuses high as compare to others. Similarly, reserved categories may have lesser cutoff than General category candidates.

faqs.question: Do the authorities release the BITSAT cutoff?
faqs.answer: Yes, the authorities release the BITSAT cutoff online every year. The cutoff score for admissions in the preferred course and campus will be available for the candidates through the BITSAT cutoff. However, the students who meet the cutoff will not be guaranteed admission but will have higher chances.

faqs.question: How is the BITSAT cutoff prepared?
faqs.answer: BITSAT cutoff is prepared after different exam and admission related factors are checked. Some factors that are checked to prepare cutoff are exam difficulty level, previous year's cutoff trends, number of seats for admission, number of applicants and more.

faqs.question: Is the counselling process centralized for all BITS campuses?

faqs.question: How is BITSAT merit list prepared?
faqs.answer: BITSAT merit list will be prepared after checking performance of students in exam. Merit list will be released as admit and wait list. Students in admit list will be eligible for admission, while those in wait list will be called in for next round of allotment.

faqs.question: Will the BITSAT 2026 toppers list be announced?

Students will be scored as per their performance in the exam. If both exam sessions are attempted, then the best score will be considered for admission.

faqs.question: What are the areas that the students should focus on in BITSAT English proficiency section?

faqs.question: What is the BITSAT 2026 seat allotment dates?

faqs.question: Can I fill out the BITSAT application form offline?

faqs.question: What is the BITSAT test centre allotment?

If these documents are not shown at the centre, the students will not be allowed to enter the centre to attempt the exam.

faqs.question: What are the BITSAT exam slot timings?
faqs.answer: BITS, Pilani, holds the BITSAT examination in two shifted sessions. The timings for the morning session are from 9 AM to 12 PM, and others are from 2 PM to 5 PM in the afternoon session. Candidates can select the BITSAT slot timings using the BITSAT slot booking system.

faqs.question: What is the mode of payment for BITSAT application fee?
faqs.answer: BITSAT application fee has to be paid to be registered for entrance exam. Fee has to be paid through credit card/debit card/net banking/ICICI payment gateway. Offline payments will not be accepted.

faqs.question: How can I choose my preferred BITSAT exam centre?
faqs.answer: Students can choose preferred BITSAT exam centre while filling application form. Preferred exam cities have to be selected in order of preference. Based on preferences, exam centres will be given to students.

faqs.question: Can I correct my details in the BITSAT application form?
faqs.answer: Yes, the students will be able to correct/edit their submitted details through the online BITSAT application correction facility. However, all information will be open for corrections. faqs.question: What is the division of questions in BITSAT pattern?
faqs.answer: The BITSAT question paper is divided into four section. For the Mathematics/Biology section, there will be 40 questions. Physics and Chemistry will have 30 questions in each section. Logical Reasoning will have 20 and English Proficiency will have 10 questions. There will 130 questions in the question paper.
